German to English and English to German translation
Clear communication is essential to building strong international connections, and BeTranslated helps you enter the German-speaking markets with confidence. With our expertise in linguistic precision and cultural awareness, we help you communicate clearly in German and create meaningful links that support your global ambitions.
Our services extend well beyond translation. We provide German interpreting services for meetings, conferences, and negotiations, so discussions run smoothly and effectively. We also offer
German subtitling services to make your audiovisual content accessible and engaging for German-speaking audiences.
Drawing on extensive experience across a range of industries – from language and property to project management and beyond – we deliver a dependable service built on quality and consistency.
Our skilled translators know German well and bring sector-specific knowledge, so your message is understood, persuasive, and relevant to your audience.
German Translation Services
Entrust us with your translation needs, and experience a service that emphasises accuracy, authenticity, and agility. Our innovative approach goes beyond mere translations, placing your narrative within German culture, so your brand and its native audience connect.
At our agency, we believe in the transformative power of language, and aim to be the catalyst that propels your business to unparalleled heights in the German-speaking realms. Partner with us to open new markets, where language opens doors to new opportunities and successful collaborations.
Join us on this journey of linguistic excellence and market expansion, as we redefine what a German translation agency can achieve, crafting a narrative that is understood, not just translated.
Professional German translators for your documents

Are you targeting new markets in Germany?
Translating your documents and website into German is an essential step if you are looking to grow your business in the booming German-speaking markets.
Employing high-quality German translation services – that is, accurate and natural-sounding texts – will allow you to communicate effectively and forge strong relationships with your clients and local partners. This strategy will undoubtedly lead to positive financial gains.

Who to trust with the translation of your German documents
Put your trust in a professional translation agency. Experience always makes the difference.
For English-German translation, BeTranslated specialises in several areas: business documents, marketing translation, web content, subtitling, technical translation, and IT documents. Furthermore, we also have expertise in the legal sector, as well as a profound knowledge of the financial and tourism industries. Whatever the subject area, we have a team of trusted German translators that you can rely on.

Professional German translation dervices for quality results
Since our top priority is customer satisfaction, we make every effort so that you can confidently entrust us with the translation of your documents. We believe that quality always comes first. That is why we offer high-quality German translation services at affordable rates.
There are a few variations of German, with the language being spoken in Austria, Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Lichtenstein, as well as Germany of course. You can rest easy, knowing that we will find you a translator that will accommodate your linguistic needs, allowing you to effectively communicate with your target audience.

German interpreting services
Our German interpreting services are an integral part of our translation offerings, providing specialised assistance across a variety of professional environments including business negotiations, legal court sessions, and medical settings.
Our experienced interpreters excel in both consecutive and simultaneous interpretation, skillfully managing sector-specific terminologies and the subtleties of German cultural contexts.
We offer adaptable on-site and remote interpreting solutions that fit the logistical requirements of our clients, so communication runs in real time across languages.
Equipped with advanced technology for uninterrupted service and committed to strict confidentiality and professionalism, we enable clients to communicate with assurance and precision, whether face-to-face or via digital platforms.

BeTranslated can handle all of your projects
By contacting a professional translation agency, you can be confident that every detail will be taken care of. Our project managers will handle everything from the receipt of your documents to the delivery of the German translation.
We will assign your text to an expert translator in the required field, and we will give your documents to a second expert for validation in the source language and format. And it goes almost without saying that we will absolutely respect the deadlines you set beforehand.
We can meet any requirement; whatever your expectations and needs may be, we will respond efficiently. We are extremely responsive, thorough, and professional.
Contact us today to find out how our German translation services can assist you with any German translation project you may have.
Our German translators
Heike
German translator specialising in marketing and business
Heike studied Literary Translation at the Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf. She has worked as a German translator and editor for over 15 years and is a member of BDÜ (German association of interpreters and translators). She excels in French and English, and is an expert in translation applications, as well as her fields of marketing, media, and business. Since 2010, Heike has taught French to German translation to possible future colleagues at the University of Düsseldorf.
Monika
French and English into German translator
Monika, a freelance translator since 2011, working from French and English into German, has lived in France since 1998. She gained her translation diploma from the CCI Dortmund in 1997, and mainly works in website translation. She has experience in translating websites for a wide spectrum of industries, from finance, tourism, and food, to the footwear and automotive businesses. She prides herself on producing accurate translations that never miss a deadline.
Pascal
German IT translator
Pascal graduated from his studies in translation in 1999, giving him over 20 years of experience in the industry, producing high-quality, professional translations. He currently lives and works in his native Germany, where he translates from both English and French into German. Pascal specialises in translation for the IT sector, but also frequently translates websites, texts related to travel and tourism, and technical documents.
